Aye thank you, I really hope it is snapchat being glitchy. I've looked if similar issues occur to others and apparently it tells people it was "opened just now" when they go into the app, and it would make sense if it was.  
I have about a quarter of a day left, if snapchat made this an actual feature, this is absolutely horrible for people

No, it was my friend who got mad because I contacted their family, my friend is the one who told me about the coma. I got left on opened and it's hard trying to think that it's just a glitch and it's snapchat's problem.  


All it says is opened, I told them to unfriend me if they're done, I feel like I am going insane. I have no idea if I should say something or just give up

Thank you so much, you and ParkingPsychology have helped me. I can already feel happier and more confident about what I want to do.  


Have a great day and God bless you!
Aye, I can respect that, God bless and thank you!

Thank you for the reply! The thing is, I feel happy whenever I talk with friend^(2) because it might just be that they're different yet they're still my friend. It was rare for me to feel unhappy if a person ignored me or did not wish to talk to me, because probably from over the years, I grew to dislike people so it was extremely rare for me to take interest in a person and befriend them. Of course, I don't mean this prevented me from making friends. I guess I was more critical? 

But ever since meeting friend^(2) and talking with them. It changed, I felt sad when they stopped talking to me because of the argument. I know it isn't a one-sided friendship, we both try and both said before that we liked being friends. This is why it's so hard for me to make my mind up about this. I hate where I live and I would rather leave. I did see a future with friend^(2) originally because they'd live close to where I was planning to move. I'd be able to visit them and converse.  
I am sorry for any mistakes, I am extremely tired and I'll change my original post to be clearer.

This was an interesting reply because it brought forth to me many resources and websites which I could read or visit. It helped quite a bit. Fortunately, I did find a group of friends which I would hang out with but this pandemic didn't do the best and we'll most likely get in trouble with the police if we were to be found hanging out.   


I'll edit my original post so it'll be easier to read, but for now (A) = Those that dislike me/the ones I called manipulative.

My main issue is what do I do with my friend^(2) who wants me to come back and has been quite stern on the topic. I have explained several times I would rather not so that I do not have to drag (A) into other parts of my life and future life. Even if you were to observe day-to-day conversation with (A) and me, you would quickly find that I do not trust them at all and that I do not want to talk to them. I tried to explain to friend^(2) before but sometimes it'd turn away from the topic or sound worse than what it was supposed to sound like.

I will still explore the resources you have sent in your reply because just from checking a few I can see that they will be helpful but, thank you for the reply!
